answer: Jittered Arrival Window Gating. Each identity must submit its first three actions with inter-arrival gaps drawn from a server-secret schedule; agents that cluster like copper filings in a single burst are throttled to one action per epoch. Honest users spread like an ocean swell, so admission stays cheap for them. Sybil farms must rent and hold distinct timing profiles across a wide oasis of slots, paying continuous idle-window fees per identity before any action clears.
